title: Applications are invited for the Pharmacopoeial Associate vacant post purely on contract basis at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), an Autonomous organization under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Ghaziabad, through Outsourcing Agency.
bodyHtml:
INDIAN PHARMACOPOEIA COMMISSION
(Ministry of Health & Family Welfare)
Government of India
Sector- 23, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad
Applications are invited for the following vacant post purely on contract basis at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), an Autonomous organization under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Ghaziabad, through Manpower Resource Outsourcing Services Providing Agency.
Details of Manpower Requirement
S. No. Details of the Positions Salary No.
of Posts		 Qualification Place of Posting Job Description
1 Name of the Post:

Pharmacopoeial Associate

Age: Not exceeding 32 years		 32,000/- 2 Qualification: Master’s degree in Pharmacy/Chemistry/ Bio-Chemistry/or equivalent.

Desirable:
Good knowledge of computers.

Experience: Minimum 0 to 03 years experience in drug testing and analysis of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API)/Drug formulations, handling of modern analytical instruments, Pharmaceutical Research etc.		 Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), Ghaziabad • Testing and Analysis of a) active pharmaceutical ingredient and related formulations as per official compendium b) New drug substances.
• Method development and validation of drugs and pharmaceuticals.
• Review of monograph for up gradation in IP etc.
Period of engagement:
The tenure of contract will be for period of one year. However, in case the work and conduct of the staff is not found to be satisfactory during the contract tenure, the services may be terminated at any time without assigning any reason thereof.
General Instructions:
1.The competent authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies and reject/select/cancellation of all applications received without assigning any reason.
1. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
2. It is not obligatory on the part of IPC or Manpower Outsourcing Service Agency to call for interview every candidate who possesses the essential qualification and experience. Preference may be given to the candidates who have desirable experience.
3. Experience/Age may be relaxed at discretion of the Competent Authority.
4. Interested candidates should submit their application online through Google Form with the following link;
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdshO_fuXby03b8MY5YNAO37u3_S0S63qdmJ8sae7maXIwbmw/viewform?vc=0&c=0&w=1&flr=0 (opens in a new tab)

No other mode of submission of application form will be accepted. The last date for submitting the application form is 10th May 2022.
